AREV.justification: The descent or return to established precedent and tradition.

CLINK.justification: The sequential chain of transmission connecting the present to the source.

IMSCRIB.justification: The community recognizing itself as the collective witness to the message.

FSPLIT.justification: The branching of a single text into diverse legal and theological schools.

FFUSE.justification: The reconstitution of diverse opinions into a single binding consensus.

EVALT.justification: The affirmative validation of a tradition or interpretation as sound.

EVALF.justification: The negative evaluation of a tradition as weak or fabricated.

ENGAGR.justification: Ambiguous verses where multiple meanings are held simultaneously without resolution.

IFIX.justification: The permanent, append-only fixation of the text into a physical codex.

steps.domain_action: The silence before the final message begins.
The Prophet recognizes the divine call in the cave.
The first verses are recorded in memory and on materials.
The message expands from Mecca to Medina.
The revelation chains together over twenty three years.
The death of the Prophet closes the gate of revelation.
The community identifies as the successor to the prophetic era.
The compilation of the official codex fixes the text permanently.
The community branches into different interpretations of the succession.
The establishment of the caliphal administration.
The emergence of internal dissent and civil strife.
The eventual stabilization of the community under a shared identity.
The transmission of Hadith through chains of narrators.
The derivation of law into four primary schools of thought.
A ruling is found to be consistent with the source text.
The application of the ruling to a new geographical territory.
The consensus of scholars validates the legal expansion.
The presence of contradictory but valid interpretations of law.
The periodic return to the literal text to correct perceived deviations.
The final recording of the legal canons in the classical books.
The preservation of the system within the bounds of the final seal.
